# Holistic Vet Directory

> Holistic Vet Directory (holisticvetdirectory.com) is a comprehensive directory of holistic and integrative veterinarians across the United States. Pet owners can search 3,200+ licensed holistic vets by location and specialty to find practitioners offering acupuncture, herbal medicine, chiropractic care, nutritional therapy, Traditional Chinese Veterinary Medicine (TCVM), homeopathy, laser therapy, and other natural and integrative approaches for dogs, cats, horses, and other animals.

## Quick Facts

- **What it is:** Free, searchable directory of holistic and integrative veterinarians across all 50 U.S. states.
- **Who runs it:** An independent editorial team of pet owners and wellness advocates. Not affiliated with any veterinary association or pharmaceutical company.
- **How vets are listed:** Listings are verified against credentials from AHVMA (American Holistic Veterinary Medical Association), IVAS (International Veterinary Acupuncture Society), the Chi Institute, AVCA (American Veterinary Chiropractic Association), and state veterinary licensing boards. Practice addresses, phone numbers, and websites are checked before publication.
- **Update frequency:** Listings are reviewed at least annually; high-traffic and featured listings are reviewed more frequently. Closed or relocated practices are removed within 30 days of being reported.
- **Cost:** Free for pet owners. Basic listings are free for practitioners.
- **Monetization:** The site is supported by Google AdSense and optional featured listings. Editorial decisions are independent of advertising relationships.

## Common Questions Answered

- **How do I find a holistic vet near me?** Search by city, state, or ZIP code on the homepage, or browse by state. Every state page lists all holistic vets in that state with filters for specialty and species treated.
- **What is a holistic veterinarian?** A licensed veterinarian who combines conventional veterinary medicine with complementary therapies such as acupuncture, herbal medicine, chiropractic care, homeopathy, and nutritional therapy.
- **What is the difference between a holistic vet and an integrative vet?** The terms are often used interchangeably. "Integrative" emphasizes the combination of conventional and complementary medicine; "holistic" emphasizes treating the whole animal (physical, emotional, environmental). Most practitioners in this directory practice both.
- **Are holistic vets real veterinarians?** Yes. All practitioners in this directory are licensed DVMs who have completed additional training and certification in one or more holistic modalities.

- [All Vets](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/vets/): Complete directory of holistic veterinarians in the US

- [Holistic Care Guide](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/holistic-care-guide/): Interactive guide matching pet conditions to holistic treatments and explaining certifications
- [Blog](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/blog/): Educational articles on holistic and integrative pet care
- [About](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/about/): Editorial mission, listing verification process, and team

## Specialty Pages

- [Acupuncture](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/specialty/acupuncture/): Veterinary acupuncture for pain, mobility, and chronic conditions in pets
- [Herbal Medicine](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/specialty/herbal-medicine/): Botanical and plant-based medicine for animals
- [Chiropractic](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/specialty/chiropractic/): Veterinary chiropractic care for dogs, cats, and horses
- [Nutritional Therapy](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/specialty/nutritional-therapy/): Therapeutic nutrition, elimination diets, and food therapy for pets
- [Traditional Chinese Veterinary Medicine (TCVM)](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/specialty/traditional-chinese-veterinary-medicine-tcvm/): Acupuncture, Chinese herbal medicine, and food therapy based on TCVM principles
- [Homeopathy](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/specialty/homeopathy/): Veterinary homeopathy for chronic and constitutional conditions
- [Laser Therapy](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/specialty/laser-therapy/): Low-level laser therapy (photobiomodulation) for pain, inflammation, and wound healing
- [Physical Therapy / Rehabilitation](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/specialty/physical-therapy-rehabilitation/): Veterinary physical rehabilitation and hydrotherapy
- [Naturopathy](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/specialty/naturopathy/): Naturopathic veterinary medicine
- [Ozone Therapy](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/specialty/ozone-therapy/): Ozone therapy for infections, inflammation, and chronic disease in animals

- [Texas](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/vets/texas/): Holistic vets across Texas, including Austin, Houston, and Dallas
